goal: Prevent malformed JSON-RPC batch elements from inheriting the preceding request's ID in error responses
Ensure error replies are not silently dropped when an invalid batch element follows a notification
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval noting it fixes spec compliance that could confuse batch RPC clients (pinheadmz)
Verified by testing that removing the fix causes test failures (janb84)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an RPC batching bug where invalid requests reuse IDs or drop error responses
Avoids confusing client applications that expect unique IDs in batch replies per JSON-RPC 2.0
Impact is narrow because it only affects error handling for malformed batch elements
